description: Navigating maritime transition pathways and energy infrastructure towards net zero (supporting data) is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Frederik Fristed (Technical University of Denmark). Overview This repository contains the code, input data and selected results supporting the manuscript “Navigating maritime transition pathways and energy infrastructure towards net zero”, currently submitted for review. It includes the applied energy system model (Balmorel.zip), the underlying input data (data.zip), and the results generated for the core maritime transition scenarios reported in the manuscript. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
